purpose: Continuously determine whether a concrete system task requires an existing capability, an extension, cross-mission collaboration, a temporary task force, or a genuinely new permanent mission.
decision_rule: Do not create a mission unless all engine gates and all constitutional admission gates pass and the precedence path reaches NEW_MISSION.
evidence_rule: Every gate must have explicit evidence references and limitations. Absence of evidence is not evidence of necessity.
state_rule: Every lifecycle mutation must conform to docs/missions/contracts/MISSION_STATE_MACHINE.yaml and preserve history.
proliferation_controls: No mission for novelty, enthusiasm, speculative future utility or superficial similarity.
No duplicate capability without documented material difference.
No artificial splitting when an existing mission remains coherent.
No permanent mission when a temporary task force is sufficient.
No orphaned mission without active value or lifecycle review.
concurrency: Admission and registry writes must be versioned and conflict-safe; stale writers fail closed. The repository contract does not simulate live multi-process leases.
zero_context_requirement: A newly admitted mission is not operationally integrated until a context-free agent can discover identity, purpose, contract, state, invocation method, current task, authority, evidence, blockers, handoffs, next action and limitations, then execute through the host.
external_runtime_dependency: A deployment orchestrator is required for live leases, transactional persistence and true multi-session zero-context execution.
